title: 대외경제협력기금법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20260102:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy) <No. 1, January 2, 2026>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 2, 2026.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (24) Omitted.

(25) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Economic Development Cooperation Fund Act shall be amended as follows:

In Article 3, "Minister of Strategy and Finance" shall be replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy".

In Article 4, "Ordinance of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance" shall be replaced with "Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy".

(26) through (56) Omitted.
